info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Treasury Bank Portfolio Administration-spec
info.description: The Treasury Bank Portfolio Administration API allows users to efficiently manage and create portfolios for treasury banking operations. This API provides endpoints to establish new banking portfolios, facilitating financial institutions and treasury managers in configuring and maintaining their financial assets. Typical consumers include banking administrators and treasury analysts who require seamless integration for automated portfolio management workflows. With this tool, users can enhance operational efficiency and ensure accurate financial oversight.

post.summary: Create a new bank portfolio in treasury.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new bank portfolio by providing the necessary details. It processes the request and stores the portfolio under the user's treasury management framework, ensuring all relevant regulations and policies are met.
